title: Users
subtitle: Every account is created here. Branch managers and cashiers are created with their branch.
name: Name
createHint: Super Admin and Finance accounts. A username and a password are generated for you.
resetPasswordBody: A new password is generated and {name} is signed out everywhere.
resetShowroomBody: A new showroom password is generated and the showroom tablets are signed out.
reset2faBody: {name} can sign in with the password only and set up 2FA again.
deactivateBody: {name} is signed out and can't sign in until reactivated.
deleteBody: {name} is removed. Their history stays in the activity log.
branchStaffNote: Branch staff are replaced from the Branches page.
roleSuperAdminHint: Full access, including users, branches and permissions.
roleFinanceHint: Sets prices and follows the orders of every branch.
selfNote: You can't change your own role or deactivate your own account.
